corrections.what: Drew the child's head as a true circle (r 12.94 about (39.41, 53.34)) whose upper-right arc is replaced by two straight strokes meeting in a small pointed corner at radius 17 px, 40 deg up from horizontal
corrections.why: DR-03, keeping the hair detail the catalogue asks to follow closely. Radial profiles show the ring is circular (outer edge 15.5 to 15.8 px from the centre) except between -55 and -25 deg, where its outer edge reaches 19.85 px at -40 deg and the ring turns a squared corner.

corrections.what: Centred the child's shoulders and both inner strokes on one axis, x 38.1
corrections.why: DR-03 symmetry. The shoulder ellipse centres at 38.18 and the inner strokes at 22.47 and 53.62. The head keeps its drawn position 1.3 px right of that axis.

corrections.what: Made the arrowhead a symmetric open chevron, arms 11.3 px back and 12.45 px out from the vertex (47.8 deg)
corrections.why: DR-03 symmetry. The arms measure 49.6 deg (upper) and 45.8 deg (lower).

corrections.what: Spaced the four record rules evenly, 17.72 px apart from y 30.57 to 83.72, and gave the upper pair one left end (x 103.6) and the lower pair another (x 107.7)
corrections.why: DR-03 equal repeats. Gaps measure 17.39, 17.8 and 17.96 px; left ends 103.75 and 103.5, then 107.25 and 108.13. Each rule keeps its own right end.

corrections.what: Gave the record's three corners one radius, 5.1 px, and made its lower-left stub vertical
corrections.why: DR-03. Diagonal profiles give 4.1, 5.5 and 5.8 px; the stub leans 0.5 px over its height.

corrections.what: Drew the coin as a true circle from the black sheet, centre (169.73, 82.29), r 26.53
corrections.why: DR-03 true circles. The annulus fit has rms 0.11 px; the red sheet fits r 26.27 about a centre 0.5 px to the right.

corrections.what: Drew every stroke at the set weight W, 5.5 px
corrections.why: DR-03 one line weight. Strokes measure 5.25 to 6.0 px.

notes: Kept: the child at left with its open shoulders ending at y 104.1 and two inner strokes, the record behind it as an open contour broken on its left side where the arrow passes (upper part stops at y 55.1, lower stub starts at y 95), its right side stopping at y 44.75 above the coin, four rules, and the coin overlapping the record's lower right. The coin's dollar sign keeps its drawn shape, a smaller upper bowl (ry 4.25) over a larger lower one (ry 5.5), with a longer top bar than bottom bar; equal bowls would move the spine up to 1.4 px. Judgement between the catalogue and the red sheet: the catalogue names only the arrow and the dollar sign as red and the coin border as black, but the red sheet draws the coin's ring red as well. The red sheet controls placement, so the arrow, the coin ring and the dollar sign are red.
